common.securedBy: This payment was processed securely through DynoPay, a trusted crypto payment gateway.
common.questions: If you have any questions, our support team is here to help.

paymentReceived.subject: Payment received - {{amount}} {{currency}}
paymentReceived.heading: Payment Received
paymentReceived.intro: Great news! Your company {{companyName}} has received a payment.
paymentReceived.outro: The funds have been forwarded to your payout wallet. You can view the full transaction details in your dashboard.

paymentPending.subject: Your payment is pending confirmation
paymentPending.heading: Payment Pending
paymentPending.intro: A new payment has been detected for your company {{companyName}}!
paymentPending.outro: We'll notify you once the payment is fully confirmed and credited to your wallet. You can track the transaction status in your DynoPay dashboard.

paymentConfirming.subject: Payment Confirming ({{current}}/{{required}}) - DynoPay
paymentConfirming.heading: Payment Confirming
paymentConfirming.intro: Good news! Your payment for {{companyName}} is being confirmed.
paymentConfirming.completeMsg: The payment has reached the required confirmations and will be credited shortly!
paymentConfirming.pendingMsg: {{remaining}} more confirmations needed before the payment is credited. You can track the full status in your DynoPay dashboard.

transactionConfirmed.subject: Transaction {{status}} - DynoPay
transactionConfirmed.heading: Transaction {{status}}
transactionConfirmed.outro: You can view more details in your DynoPay dashboard.

paymentPartial.subject: Partial payment received — action needed
paymentPartial.heading: Partial Payment Received
paymentPartial.intro: A partial payment has been received for your company {{companyName}}.
paymentPartial.actionText: You have {{minutes}} minutes to send the remaining {{remaining}} {{currency}} to complete this payment.
paymentPartial.graceNote: If the remaining amount is received within {{minutes}} minutes, the full payment will be processed. If the grace period expires, the partial amount will be processed with adjusted fees.

paymentPartialExpired.introCompleted: The partial payment for your company {{companyName}} has been processed.
paymentPartialExpired.introExpired: The grace period for the partial payment to your company {{companyName}} has expired.
paymentPartialExpired.outroCompleted: The received amount has been processed with adjusted fees and forwarded to your wallet.
paymentPartialExpired.outroExpired: Since the full payment was not received within the grace period, the partial amount has been processed. Please note that fees may be higher for incomplete payments.
paymentPartialExpired.viewDetails: You can view the transaction details in your DynoPay dashboard.

paymentFailed.reasonUnderpaid: We received {{paidAmount}} {{currency}} but the required amount was {{amount}} {{currency}}
paymentFailed.subject: Payment unsuccessful - {{companyName}}
paymentFailed.heading: Payment Unsuccessful
paymentFailed.customerIntro: Unfortunately, your payment to {{companyName}} was not completed.
paymentFailed.underpaidNote: Please contact {{companyName}} to resolve this underpayment or request a refund.
paymentFailed.expiredNote: Please contact {{companyName}} if you still wish to complete this payment.
paymentFailed.merchantIntro: A payment from {{customerName}} was not completed.
paymentFailed.merchantUnderpaidNote: The customer has been notified. You may need to issue a partial refund or request the remaining amount.

customerPaymentConfirmation.subject: Payment Successful - Receipt from {{companyName}}
customerPaymentConfirmation.heading: Payment Successful
customerPaymentConfirmation.intro: Your payment to {{companyName}} has been successfully processed.
customerPaymentConfirmation.pdfAttached: PDF Receipt Attached - A detailed receipt is attached to this email for your records.
customerPaymentConfirmation.contact: If you have any questions about this payment, please contact {{companyName}} directly.
